name: feedback
description: A two-sided loop for improving agent plugins from test sessions. The 'session' skill (tester side) turns the current session record into a copy-pasteable report grading the plugins exercised; the 'triage' skill (author side) aggregates many reports into a prioritized action plan, routing each finding to a concrete fix. Both share one report-format contract.

interface.shortDescription: Grade plugin surfaces from a test session
interface.longDescription: Tester-side session reports grading the plugin surfaces exercised, and author-side triage that clusters many reports into a routed action plan.
defaultPrompt: Write up testing feedback for this session.
